entry.description: `XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J` formats from a copy of the event's properties and no longer adds `log4jmachinename`, `log4japp`, `log4net:Identity` and `log4net:UserName` to the event. Adding them could break a concurrent flush of a buffering appender. Visible change: appenders that run after it on the same event no longer see these four keys (ANT-2026-L9XQVDSD, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
